name: adaptive-guidelines
description: Reuse durable project lessons and learn from corrections, agent mistakes, and wasted effort.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse lessons and learn from mistakes across workflows
interface.longDescription: Find relevant lessons before work, capture corrections, agent mistakes, and wasted effort, assess later reuse, and retire outdated observations. Promote or revise official guidelines only with approval.
defaultPrompt: Use $adaptive-guidelines to consult relevant saved lessons before starting this work.
Use $adaptive-guidelines capture to save lessons from corrections, agent mistakes, and wasted effort in this work.
Use $adaptive-guidelines status to show current observations and candidates.
